canonical.full_scope: Version/chunk queue envelopes by serialized byte and batch budgets, including shared inputs without breaking readers. Define durable recovery for producer rejection, invalid/quarantined records and partial writes; DLQ in each environment; validate fan-out responses and reconcile counts to sinks. Fault tests cover oversize, outage, malformed records, retry/regroup, duplicate sends and recovery. Logging/DLQ alone is not closure.
